localContext: Wheaton's mature tree canopy, especially around Wheaton College and older blocks, offers beauty but also unique challenges for garage doors. Homes from the 1950s through 1970s often feature original garage door systems. These are particularly susceptible to environmental stress. Every storm season brings track-obstruction and panel-dent calls. Falling tree limbs and seed debris routinely foul tracks and photo eyes. This prevents doors from closing properly. These conditions lead to broken springs, damaged panels, or doors coming off their tracks. We understand these local demands on Wheaton garage doors. We are prepared for them.
